title: Road Pavement Condition Assessment

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Road Pavement Condition Assessment": Measure cracks, potholes and rutting from vehicle-mounted and drone imagery so maintenance budgets target the roads that need repair. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Raw image storage.
